title: Common-unit seed for finite direct-image comparison
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_finitePush_unit_seed
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f) :
    (p.finitePushUnit l ≫
        p.Rf.R.map (p.coefficientsX.unitMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) p.LX)) ≫
        p.limits.iso.hom.app (p.restrictionX.F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (SpTowerClasses.unit X (SpTowerClasses.Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X))) =
      p.coefficientsS.unitMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) p.LS ≫
        p.LS.R.map (p.restrictionS.F.mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((SpTowerShriek.adjunction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) p.base p.model.geometry).homEquiv _ _
            (p.model.coefficientPullback.derivedIso l (ULift.{u} (Padic l))).hom)) ≫
        p.LS.R.map (p.varying.hom.app
          (SpTowerClasses.unit X (SpTowerClasses.Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) X)))

proof.text: Evaluate the completed exact square on the degree-zero complex of the completed coefficient unit and use its common-unit normalization to replace the completed push unit by the ordinary direct-image unit.
Unfold the coefficient cone comparison and use coefficient_one and coefficient_projection to identify its unit component with the ordinary finite quotient map.
Apply the coefficient-pullback normalization and the limit-square common-unit equation, then use naturality of the varying comparison to obtain the displayed seed equality.
